Contract ManageCashierCRUDService::createCashier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashier: Cashier = Cashier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isCashierExist: Boolean = if cashier.oclIsUndefined() 
		then false 
		else true 
		endif 
	precondition:
		cashier.oclIsUndefined() = isCashierExist
	postcondition:
		if isCashierExist = false 
		then let newCashier: Cashier in
		newCashier.oclIsNew() and
		Cashier.allInstance()->includes(newCashier) and
		newCashier.Id = id and
		newCashier.Name = name and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
